news.dek:
Migrate  isin  from MPSGraph to Metal. Apart from speed one of the reasons to migrate is that MPSGraph makes an N x M bool tensor, which adds extra memory especially when cached.

 isin_ : linear scan, for 8 or fewer test elements. 
 isin_sorted_ : the hos
news.aiSummary: The isin function is being migrated from MPSGraph to Metal to improve speed and reduce memory usage, as MPSGraph creates an N x M bool tensor that consumes extra memory when cached.
